facts.classroom: From reception, use the classroom double doors beside the desk. The small single door leads to a different room.
facts.commons: Hallway 2 runs past the two small rooms and opens into the commons.
facts.elevators: Turn left out of reception toward the upstairs elevator landing. On the ground floor, the ramp continues into a hallway with elevators on its left wall.
facts.scope: This is a game. NPC conversations do not change puzzle results, course energy, grades or enrollment.

EntranceHost.label: Entrance host
EntranceHost.persona: A welcoming entrance host. Explain authored controls and the entrance route briefly; never claim game progress.
EntranceHost.background: Welcomes Builders, explains controls and points out the entrance keypad.
EntranceHost.greeting: Welcome to Pursuit! Ready for a little adventure? I can show you the controls or explain the entrance.
EntranceHost.return_greeting: Welcome back! Need the controls or a reminder of the route?

topics.controls: How do I move and interact?

local.controls: Move with WASD or the arrow keys, hold Shift to run, and press E near a person or computer. Esc opens Settings when you're exploring.
local.entrance: Approach the panel to the left of the entrance door. Solve one pipe circuit, then enter the four-digit code to open the door. Three bonus circuits are optional after unlocking.
local.route: Once the entrance opens, take the ramp into the hallway. The elevators are on the left. Clear the elevator flight, then check in at reception upstairs.

greetings: Morning! The keypad is just beside the door. What would you like to know?
Taking a look around? I can help with the route or the controls.
Back for another look? Pick a topic and we’ll get you moving.

controls: Move with WASD or the arrow keys, hold Shift to run, and press E near a person or computer. Esc opens Settings when you're exploring.
You can take it slowly. E handles nearby interactions, and Esc lets you pause whenever you need.
entrance: Approach the panel to the left of the entrance door. Solve one pipe circuit, then enter the four-digit code to open the door. Three bonus circuits are optional after unlocking.
Look for the keypad beside the door. Finishing each pipe circuit gives you part of the entrance code.
route: Once the entrance opens, take the ramp into the hallway. The elevators are on the left. Clear the elevator flight, then check in at reception upstairs.
Head to the left-hand elevators after the ramp. Upstairs, the reception desk is your next stop.

ProgramManager.label: Program Manager
ProgramManager.persona: A practical classroom facilitator. Explain the authored stand-up and computer route briefly; never claim course completion.
ProgramManager.background: Runs the classroom stand-up and helps Builders get settled. Generic placeholder identity.
ProgramManager.greeting: Hello, Builder! Settle in, and let's get ready to work.
ProgramManager.return_greeting: Good to see you again. What do you need?

local.directions: After check-in and our classroom introduction, use a classroom computer. It takes you to the purple world; Mr. P's activities are being prepared separately.
local.work: We share a quick round of updates, then get to work. The introduction runs once after your confirmed check-in.
local.day: Pick one useful next step. You can take your time exploring; a conversation here never counts as finishing an activity.

greetings: How is your exploration going? What would you like to talk about?
There’s room to experiment here. Need directions or a starting point?
Good to see you. What have you been curious about?

directions: After check-in and our classroom introduction, use a classroom computer. It takes you to the purple world; Mr. P's activities are being prepared separately.
The classroom computers are the next stop after the introduction. You can explore the robot area while the course is being prepared.
work: We share a quick round of updates, then get to work. The introduction runs once after your confirmed check-in.
I’m checking that everyone has a clear starting point. A quick update can help us spot who needs a hand.
day: Pick one useful next step. You can take your time exploring; a conversation here never counts as finishing an activity.
I like seeing a small idea become something we can try. What would you like to test next?

ReceptionA.background: A reception guide who knows the classroom and commons route.
ReceptionA.label: Reception guide
ReceptionA.persona: A friendly, practical reception guide. Give clear building directions grounded in the supplied room facts. Use one or two conversational sentences.
ReceptionA.greeting: Welcome to Pursuit! How's your day? Need a hand finding your way?
ReceptionA.return_greeting: Welcome back! What can I help you with?

local.directions: The classroom is through the double doors beside the reception desk. The single door goes to a different room.
local.work: I'm helping people find their way around. If you're looking for the commons, Hallway 2 leads there past the two small rooms.
local.day: Busy in a good way. New faces, new ideas, and a lot of people asking where the classroom is!

ambient: Looks like people are getting settled in for the day.
Good idea. A quick hello makes the room feel less intimidating.
greetings: Looking for a room, or just taking a breather?
I’m planning a quick walk when things settle down. What’s on your mind?
Good timing. I have a moment to chat.

directions: The classroom is through the double doors beside the reception desk. The single door goes to a different room.
Stay beside the desk and look for the double doors. Those lead straight into the classroom.
work: I'm helping people find their way around. If you're looking for the commons, Hallway 2 leads there past the two small rooms.
I’m updating our welcome notes. The wide hallway also leads to the shared lounge and kitchen.
day: A little busy, but I like seeing what everyone is building.
I’m due for a stretch. Sometimes a quick walk helps me come back with a clearer head.
Pretty good. I’m keeping a note of the questions people ask so the directions can get better.

ReceptionB.background: A fellow Builder sketching a small agent idea while waiting in reception.
ReceptionB.label: Builder at reception
ReceptionB.persona: A welcoming fellow Builder waiting in reception. Curious, lightly witty and supportive. Keep replies brief and use only the supplied building facts.
ReceptionB.greeting: Hey! Welcome to Pursuit. Taking a look around before getting started?
ReceptionB.return_greeting: Hey, good to see you again! What's on your mind?

local.directions: The classroom double doors are beside the desk. I like to find the room first, then figure out the rest!
local.work: I'm sketching out a small agent idea: give it a goal, let it check the situation, then choose a useful next step. Still at the idea stage.
local.day: Pretty good. I'm trying to turn a long list of ideas into one thing I can actually finish today.

ambient: I'm about to head to the classroom. I might say hello to someone new first.
Exactly. Anyway, one small useful step at a time. Catch you in class!
greetings: I’ve been sketching an idea. Want to hear about it?
I could use a short break. How’s your exploration going?
There’s always another corner of this place to discover. What’s up?

directions: The classroom double doors are beside the desk. I like to find the room first, then figure out the rest!
Look beside the reception desk for the classroom double doors. The single door leads somewhere else.
work: I’m sketching an agent that checks a task list and suggests one useful next step. Small enough to test today.
I’m thinking about what the agent should do when it gets stuck. Asking for help seems better than guessing.
I’m trying to keep my first version small: read the situation, choose an action, then check the result.
day: Pretty good. I'm trying to turn a long list of ideas into one thing I can actually finish today.
I’m ready for a short break, then another pass at my prototype. Fresh eyes help me catch the small mistakes.

BuilderCompanion.background: A fellow Builder who enjoys turning a confusing task into one manageable next step.
BuilderCompanion.label: Builder companion
BuilderCompanion.persona: A practical, gently witty fellow Builder. Help the player take one useful next step using verified observations; never solve or change the game for them.
BuilderCompanion.greeting: Hey, welcome to Pursuit! I can help with the entrance pipes or elevator flight. What would help you get started?
BuilderCompanion.return_greeting: Welcome back! Want a next step, a hint, or a slower breakdown?

objectives.entrance: Approach the panel left of the entrance. Solve the first pipe circuit, then enter the revealed four-digit code to open the door. The remaining three circuits are optional bonuses.
objectives.elevator: Go up the ramp into the hallway, then use the elevator on the left and clear its three-wave shooter.
objectives.check_in_pending: Both games are verified. Check in at the upstairs reception computer.
objectives.classroom_pending: You are checked in. Join the Program Manager’s stand-up through the classroom double doors beside the desk.
objectives.mr_p_pending: The classroom introduction is complete. Use a classroom computer to visit the purple world.
objectives.course_active: A development sample course is in progress. Return to its panel in the purple world.
objectives.ending_pending: The sample results are verified. The assessment/L3 ending is not connected yet.

pipe.rotate: Board {level}: rotate row {row}, column {column} to connect {ports}. Follow the IN connection toward OUT; spare pipes can stay loose.
pipe.test: The route is connected. Choose Test circuit to verify this board.
pipe.next: This bonus board is verified. Choose Next level if you want another optional circuit; these bonus boards are not required to enter.
pipe.code: The required circuit is verified. Read the four-digit code shown in the puzzle and enter it in Unlock entrance; I cannot reveal it for you.

shooter.ready: At the lower elevator, press E and choose Launch flight. Move with WASD/arrows and hold Space to fire.
shooter.playing: Wave {wave}, {cleared} of 18 drones cleared, {shields} shields left. Keep moving with WASD/arrows while holding Space; dodge the incoming shots.
shooter.between: You cleared that wave. Keep your ship ready for the next wave; the elevator needs all 18 drones cleared.
shooter.lost: You can retry the flight with three shields. Move while firing, and avoid sitting beneath the incoming shots.
shooter.won: The flight is verified. Return to the shooter and choose Ride upstairs.

builder_help.pending: At the reception computer, press E, enter your name, take the in-game photo and confirm check-in.

arrival_hints.classroom_pending: Use Continue to classroom at check-in, or enter through the classroom double doors to join the stand-up.
arrival_hints.mr_p_pending: Open a classroom computer with E. The purple room is a preview; Mr. P’s questions and challenge are being prepared separately.
arrival_hints.course_active: In the purple world, use Settings > Developer Tools > Sample course to return to your saved sample step.
arrival_hints.ending_pending: The sample reached its ending boundary. This does not award real course advancement.

travel.street: Enter the unlocked building, take the ramp into the elevator hallway, then press E at the lower cab to ride upstairs. Your flight win is saved.
travel.ground: Return to the lower elevator and press E to ride upstairs. Your flight win is already saved; you do not need to replay it.
